plan_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-C - Human-Only Git Preservation & Archival Plan
plan_metadata.author_role: Independent Research Governance Officer & Evidence Preservation Specialist
plan_metadata.agent_constraint: ZERO AGENT GIT MUTATIONS. All commands are instructions for human owner execution only.

preservation_principles: No broad 'git add -A' or 'git add .': broad additions risk staging ignored caches, secrets, or temporary files.
Explicit file-level additions: Stage only verified public-safe markdown reports, strategy candidates, engine oracles, and evidence ledgers.
Strict exclusion of sealed Tier 3: tiingo_cache/ must remain ignored in .gitignore and never committed.
Zero data loss: All untracked research evidence remains intact on disk.
No remote push: Push is strictly unauthorized; archival is local to the repository.
